summary: The candidate fixes the demonstrated DCP-widened no-RoPE MLA KV-scatter indexing and reserved-slot defect. The exact regression fails on the recorded base and passes on the exact candidate, and an independent GPU matrix found no counterexample. The original eight-B200 GLM-5.3 serving crash remains unverified in this single-gfx950 ROCm environment.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before behavior of the candidate's unchanged three-test regression on the prepared base; all three failed on GPU.
Passing-after behavior of the exact candidate regression; 3 passed.

tests.command: independent inline PyTorch-reference GPU matrix retained at /job/review-evidence/adversarial/matrix.txt
tests.what_was_measured: 130 no-RoPE DCP scatter cases plus empty input across DCP sizes 2/3/8, all ranks, int32/int64 locations, arbitrary reserved index, and dimensions 1/127/128/129/513.
Candidate file regression suite: 8 passed, 58 CUDA-TMA-only tests skipped on ROCm.

gpu_execution.evidence: All focused and adversarial kernels executed on AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-; torch.cuda.synchronize completed after the independent matrix.

native_rebuild_reason: The candidate changes Python/Triton source and tests only; no native C++ or FlyDSL compiler source changed. Triton JIT compiled the exercised kernels for gfx950.
remaining_limitations: No NVIDIA B200 or CUDA 13 environment was available, so CUDA code generation and the reported architecture-specific illegal-memory-access symptom were not tested.
Only one GPU was assigned; TP8/DCP8 communication and multi-rank process behavior were simulated one rank at a time through the real GPU kernel.
GLM-5.3 weights were unavailable; full-model semantics, 262144 context, chunked prefill, HiCache, and the complete serving command were not run.
FlashInfer TRT-LLM MLA execution was not available on ROCm; this review verifies the upstream KV-scatter contract feeding that path, not the downstream CUDA attention kernel.
The 58 skipped tests in the full file require NVIDIA TMA/SM90+ and do not exercise the changed no-RoPE DCP branch.
